mapper.select: SELECT AI_INPT_LIST_ID , AI_INPT_LIST_NM FROM CSPD103TI WHERE AI_INPT_LIST_YN = 'Y'
mapper.sql:
WHERE (A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL OR A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL) AND B.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
AND B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd}
AND B.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
AND A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = {#inptSanctionNo} AND (A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT = {#aiInptListText} OR A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT= {#aiInptListText}) AND A.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN='Y'

WHERE (A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL OR A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL) AND B.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
AND B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd}
AND B.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
AND A.INPT_SANCTION_NO IN (#{inptSanctionNo1}, #{inptSanctionNo2}, #{inptSanctionNo3}, #{inptSanctionNo4}, #{inptSanctionNo5})
AND A.INPT_SANCTION_NO IN (#{inptSanctionNo1}, #{inptSanctionNo2}, #{inptSanctionNo3}, #{inptSanctionNo4})
AND A.INPT_SANCTION_NO IN (#{inptSanctionNo1}, #{inptSanctionNo2}, #{inptSanctionNo3})
AND A.INPT_SANCTION_NO IN (#{inptSanctionNo1}, #{inptSanctionNo2})
AND A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo1}
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD004TF A JOIN CSPD001TM B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO
ORDER BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO

SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_SANCTION_NO , CASE WHEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT ELSE A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT END AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT FROM CSPD004TF A JOIN CSPD001TM B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO
ORDER BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO, CASE WHEN A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo1} THEN 1 WHEN A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo2} THEN 2 WHEN A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo3} THEN 3 WHEN A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo4} THEN 4 WHEN A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo5} THEN 5 ELSE 99 END

SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_SANCTION_NO , CASE WHEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT ELSE A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT END AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT FROM CSPD004TF A JOIN CSPD001TM B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO

SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_SANCTION_NO , CASE WHEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT ELSE A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT END AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT FROM CSPD004TF A JOIN CSPD001TM B ON B.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO

SELECT B.INPT_MST_SRNO , UPPER(CASE WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '05' THEN A.CUS_KORL_NM WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '08' THEN A.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '10' THEN A.XPO_PTN_NACD WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '11' THEN A.HS_CD WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '13' THEN A.DACC_BRCD END) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT , {#inptSanctionNo} AS INPT_SANCTION_NO FROM CSPD201TM A, CSPD001TM B WHERE B.ACTL_FX_REFNO = A.FX_ACNO AND B.FX_REFNO_SRNO = A.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AND A.XPO_CVRG_MTBR_MK_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
AND A.CUS_KORL_NM LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{aiInptListText}) || '%'
AND A.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{aiInptListText}) || '%'
AND A.XPO_PTN_NACD LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{aiInptListText}) || '%'
AND A.HS_CD LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{aiInptListText}) || '%'
AND A.DACC_BRCD LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{aiInptListText}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT B.INPT_MST_SRNO , UPPER(CASE WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '05' THEN A.CUS_KORL_NM WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '08' THEN A.TDOC_RCP_CUCD WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '10' THEN A.XPO_NACD WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '11' THEN A.HS_CD WHEN {#inptSanctionNo} = '13' THEN A.DACC_BRCD END) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT , {#inptSanctionNo} AS INPT_SANCTION_NO FROM CSPD202TM A, CSPD001TM B WHERE B.ACTL_FX_REFNO = A.FX_ACNO AND B.FX_REFNO_SRNO = A.TDOC_RCP_SRNO AND A.TDOC_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')

AND A.XPO_NACD LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{aiInptListText}) || '%'
